card.name: The word institutional before policy
card.fires_on: The word "institutional" in phrases like "per institutional guidelines" or "institutional policy" in drug label instructions. It also fires weakly on "ial" in "Nosocomial".

modes.label: Per institutional policy
modes.description: "institutional" follows "per" and points to local guidelines or policy for handling or management.
modes.example: Waste residual medication per<< institutional>> policy.

modes.label: Institutional limits or protocols
modes.description: "institutional" modifies a protocol or normal-range term.

modes.label: End of nosocomial
modes.description: The ending of the word "nosocomial" in infection indications.
